reason: I already invest for free on Robinhood and ask Claude my money questions for nothing, so a monthly fee just to have a pet do the trades isn't something I'm signing up for, especially when they won't even say what it costs. I might mess around with the free demo money on my commute, but I'm not joining a waitlist for a paid plan.
objection: I'm not paying a subscription to invest, and on top of that I'd be handing real money to an AI agent through a broker partner that doesn't exist yet, with no price and no track record.
would_change_my_mind: If the demo agent clearly beat what I do on my own for a few months, and the real-money plan came in around Robinhood Gold's price with a named, licensed broker holding my money.
